title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on the number they want. The market only cares about the number it will support.

Closed sales data from the past 90 days tells a clear story. Homes on Bayshore Boulevard, in Hyde Park, and on Davis Islands that were priced within 2% of their actual market value went under contract faster and, in many cases, generated competing offers that pushed the final sale price above asking. Homes that opened 5% or more above market sat, then reduced, then sold below where a sharper price would have landed them from day one.

Condition compounds this. Updated kitchens and primary baths, fresh exterior paint, and clean landscaping are not just aesthetic. They shift how a buyer weighs risk. A buyer who sees deferred maintenance starts discounting mentally before they even make an offer.

Timing adds another layer. South Tampa inventory typically tightens between February and May, which historically creates the strongest leverage for sellers. Listing ahead of that window, when buyers are actively searching but fewer homes are available, has consistently produced stronger outcomes than waiting for peak season.

Price sharp, present well, and understand the seasonal rhythm of this specific market. That combination is what moves the number in the right direction.
